games.name: [🎃] Alkedion PVP
games.desc:
ALKEDION PVP

Welcome to Alkedion PVP, a fast-paced third-person shooter where every fight is all about skill, movement, and teamwork. Challenge players from around the world, create your own clan, and prove yourself on the battlefield.

🎮 Game Modes

• Free For All (FFA)
• 1v1 Duels
• 2v2 - 5v5 Team Battles & Clan Wars

✨ Features

• Smooth and responsive third-person combat
• Roll, sprint, crouch, and outplay your opponents
• Collect unique weapon skins and effects
• Create or join a clan and compete with others
• Climb the leaderboards and earn rewards
• Frequent events, giveaways, and new content

🏆 Progress

Win matches, unlock rewards, improve your skills, and become one of the strongest players in Alkedion.

🖥️ PC Controls

• WASD – Move
• Mouse – Aim
• Left Click – Shoot
• Right Click – Aim / Zoom
• Space – Roll / Dodge
• Shift – Sprint
• C – Crouch
• R – Reload
• V – Open Inventory

❤️ Enjoying the game? Like, Favorite, and Follow to support future updates.

games.name: [VAMPIRE] Vesteria
games.desc:
You are an adventurer traveling by carriage when your journey is cut short by a monster attack. You awaken in a strange mushroom town, far from where you intended to go. As you help the people of Mushtown, you grow stronger, uncover the world’s secrets, and begin to understand the forces shaping Vesteria.

Vesteria is an open-world MMORPG on Roblox, shaped by a highly engaged community and a living player-driven economy. Explore sprawling cities, distant regions, and handcrafted worlds, take on dangerous dungeons and bosses, and trade rare items through a thriving global marketplace.

✨ Upon reaching Level 10 in Mushtown, follow the path to Nilgarf to meet the Baron and begin your journey as a Warrior, Hunter, or Mage.

🌎 Multiple cities, regions, and worlds to explore
⚔️ Challenging bosses and dungeons
🏛️ Global marketplace driven by players
👥 Passionate, long-running community

© 2026 Vesteria, Inc. Vesteria® and the Vesteria logo are registered trademarks of Vesteria, Inc.

games.name: SPECTER
games.desc:
Experiments gone wrong have unleashed ghosts across the world. Explore, discover paranormal evidence, and uncover the dark secrets hidden within 15+ haunted locations.

These ghosts are extremely dangerous. Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt phase.

Need more help? Use the journal's FAQ section during a match, or check out our server.

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
⚙️ An extensive settings menu is available in the lobby! Customize your experience to your liking.
🎧 We recommend using headphones for the best experience.
🎙️ Spirit Box and the team radio feature supports voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free, you are free to use them in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.
